# OmKiran Bhakti

> Hindi devotional website of the OmKiran Bhakti YouTube channel: 122 traditional aartis, chalisas, stotras, mantras and vrat kathas with line-by-line plain-Hindi meanings; a daily Hindu panchang (New Delhi); festival dates computed from tithi rules; city-wise festival timings for 65+ Indian cities and the diaspora; and a free online jaap mala.

Official YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@OmKiranBhakti
Panchang method: sidereal (Lahiri ayanamsa) positions from PyEphem, udaya tithi, purnimanta months; festivals follow their traditional kaal rule (sunrise, pradosh, moonrise, nishita).

## Upcoming festivals (dates for New Delhi)
